fields.label: Institution Code
fields.description: Any code from https://allratestoday.com/central-bank-rates-api/institutions/ (e.g. snb, cbuae, boe)

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Needed only for live market rates (free API key at https://allratestoday.com/register). A paid-plan key also lets the ERPNext provider preset use the official table of RBI, ECB or another bank on any date.

fields.label: Live Sync Frequency
fields.description: Each sync is one API call. Hourly suits paid plans.

fields.label: Base Currency
fields.description: Usually your company currency. Blank = currency of the default company.

fields.label: Currencies
fields.description: Foreign currencies to load. Blank = every currency the source publishes that is enabled in ERPNext.

fields.label: Write separate Buying and Selling rates
fields.description: For bank TT cards and CBIC (import/export)

fields.label: Also write the inverse pair
fields.description: e.g. INR to USD as well as USD to INR

fields.label: Rate Direction Note
fields.options:
Direction. ERPNext stores a rate as 1 From Currency = Exchange Rate To Currency. RBI publishes 1 USD = 95.25 INR, so the app writes From = USD, To = INR (your base currency), Exchange Rate = 95.25. Per-100 quotes (JPY, IDR, KRW) arrive already normalised to 1 unit.

Buying / selling. With the split option on, bank TT cards write the bank's TT selling rate as the Buying record (purchases) and the TT buying rate as the Selling record (sales); CBIC writes the import rate as Buying and the export rate as Selling. With it off, one record is written for both: the TT buying rate (Income-tax Rule 115) for bank cards, the import rate for CBIC.
